raw.details:
About the Organizing Institution:

  • Dr. Ambedkar Institute of Technology (Dr. AIT), Bengaluru
  • Established in 1980 by Late Sri M. H. Jayaprakash Narayan
  • Autonomous Institution
  • Aided by Government of Karnataka
  • Affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi
  • Approved by AICTE, New Delhi
  • Accredited by NAAC with A+ Grade
  • Eligible programs accredited by NBA

About the Colossus 3.O Hackathon

Dr. Shylaja K. R., Dean - R&D Dr. AIT, and Mr. Chetan N, SWO Dr. AIT presents  Colossus 3.O - 24Hrs National Level Hackathon

COLOSSUS is the flagship hackathon of Dr. Ambedkar Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, now in its third edition. Student teams take on real problem statements across six domains, compete in an online screening round, and the top teams build their solutions end-to-end in a 24-hour offline finale.

Domains/Tracks

Teams must select one of 6 domains:

  • AgriTech
  • FinTech
  • Cybersecurity
  • HealthTech
  • Hardware / IoT & Robotics
  • Open Innovation

JOIN OUR WHATSAPP COMMUNITY FOR UPDATES: ( https://chat.whatsapp.com/EFf3z2Ex4cB5EGADZx0jyM )

Hackathon Structure

Round 1 - Online Screening

  • Free registration
  • Teams submit their entries online.
  • Official PPT template is mandatory
  • College/institution name, logo or identifying information must not appear in the PPT
  • The PPT Submission Fomrat will be only in PDF
  • TeamName_track  should be the name of the PDF while submitting.
  • 60 teams shortlisted for the offline round 2
  • The Shorlisted teams will be contacted to pay the Team Registration fees of Rs.800
    Note: The Team Registration fees is fixed for each team, irrespective of number of participants in the team.
  • The final offline participation email will be sent to the shortlisted teams.

Round 2 - Offline Hackathon

  • 24-hour offline hackathon
  • Venue: Sports Complex - Dr. Ambedkar Institute of Technology, Bengaluru 560056
  • Only shortlisted teams can participate
  • All teams members must be physically present throughout the event.

Important Rules

  • All work for the 24-hour round must be done during the event.
  • Open-source libraries and APIs are allowed with proper credit.
  • Plagiarism and pre-built projects are prohibited.
  • Participants must bring their own laptops, chargers and required hardware.
  • Participants must carry a valid college ID.
  • Teams must carry an extension board/extension cord.
